# Respiratory Risk Report


### Week ending in November 7, 2026


[Kait Hess Jimenez, MS](https://substack.com/@kaithessjimenez)


Nov 13, 2026


Despite a small plateau last week, Biobot’s national wastewater network shows a small increase in covid this week. It is still too early to tell if covid will continue to increase in the coming weeks or continue to fluctuate at a high level as we have been seeing over the last month.


Flu A continues to rise nationally across all four regions, while flu B continues to remain at very low levels. RSV is beginning to gradually increase, but its activity is still very low relative to the peak last winter. HMPV continues to decline.


**Bottom line**


Covid is still circulating at elevated levels and is fluctuating, while flu A and RSV are increasing. As we approach the holidays, we can expect flu and RSV transmission to continue increasing, while it remains unclear how Covid will evolve.


If you haven’t yet, there is still time to schedule your fall vaccines. Which vaccines are recommended depends on your age, health history, and risk factors, so check with your healthcare provider. Most are also available at pharmacies or walk-in clinics.


---


### **National Outlook**


**COVID-19**


Nationally, SARS-CoV-2 is fluctuating, modestly increasing.


**Influenza**


Nationally, influenza A is increasing, while influenza B is holding steady at very low levels.


**RSV**


Nationally, RSV is increasing.


**HMPV**


Nationally, HMPV is decreasing and remains low.


---

**COVID-19:** SARS-CoV-2 is fluctuating.


**Influenza:** Influenza A is increasing, while influenza B is holding steady at very low levels.


**RSV:** RSV is increasing.


**HMPV:** HMPV is holding steady.


#### **The Midwest**

**Influenza** : Influenza A is increasing, while influenza B is holding steady at very low levels.


**RSV** : RSV is holding steady.


**HMPV:** HMPV is decreasing.


#### **The Northeast**


**COVID-19:** SARS-CoV-2 is increasing.


**RSV:** RSV is holding steady.


**HMPV:** HMPV is decreasing.


#### **The West**


**COVID-19:** SARS-CoV-2 is fluctuating.


**RSV:** RSV is holding steady.


**HMPV:** HMPV is decreasing.

---


*Wastewater data from Biobot Analytics for RSV, influenza, HMPV, and SARS-CoV-2 are through November 7, 2026 (MMWR week 44).*
